description.value: The geomancer summons a luopan (a small orb that floats just above the ground that is a pylon of geomantic energies) within the spell range that has hit points equal to 10 x the geomancer’s level and a hardness equal to its spell level. This luopan emits the effect in the area of the luopan that affects specified targets. When the duration is over, the luopan is unsummoned. The affected allies within the selective area receive the Haste status effect. The subject receives a +1 dodge bonus to AC, +1 bonus to Attack rolls, +1 bonus to Reflex saves, +30 foot movement, and an extra attack if the subject uses a full-attack option.
